subject: Compliance roadmap questions: ISO 27001, FedRAMP readiness, and audit evidence
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance roadmap questions: ISO 27001, FedRAMP readiness, and audit evidence

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme Health is excited about Redwood's performance and the routing options. Before we proceed to procurement, our security team has a few high-level roadmap questions so we can map your timeline to our certification requirements: 

- Do you have an ISO 27001 certification roadmap (target date, scope)?
- What is Redwood's current FedRAMP posture and expected timeline to be FedRAMP-ready/authorized?
- Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report, and do you use SIG/CAIQ for supplier assessments?

Our procurement/security folks also want to understand upcoming audits or major compliance milestones that could affect the platform SLA or data residency options.

Can you loop in your security lead and share any evidence or short readouts you can provide (redacted reports are fine). We need the info by the end of next week to keep our vendor review on schedule.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Chen
Senior Security Program Manager | Acme Health
olivia.chen@acmehealth.com

Attachment: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance roadmap questions: ISO 27001, FedRAMP readiness, and audit evidence

Hi Olivia — thanks for the thoughtful list. Looping in Mina (security lead) and Monica (CS) who will help with the evidence and timeline. Quick high-level answers below; Mina will follow with the definitive artifacts and our redaction process.

- ISO 27001: We are in active scoping and gap remediation. Target: certification audit window in Q4 2026; initial scope will cover our core hosted API (control plane + data plane for hosted customers). We can share the scope doc and the Statement of Applicability draft.
- FedRAMP: We have initiated a FedRAMP readiness assessment (third-party assessor engaged) targeting "FedRAMP Ready" / Ready-to-onboard customers in H1 2027. Full authorization depends on sponsoring agency timelines — we will provide a readiness report and the ATO playbook.
- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II for the 12-month period ending 2025; we can provide a redacted PDF and a non-disclosure flow for unredacted review.
- SIG/CAIQ: We maintain an up-to-date SIG profile and CAIQ answers; we usually provide the SIG for accounts undergoing in-depth assessments and the CAIQ as a quick questionnaire.

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Roadmap_Q1-2026.pdf (high-level milestones + owner matrix) — I've uploaded it to our shared drive (link below). Monica will work with you on any procurement-specific templates.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/Compliance/Roadmap_Q1-2026
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-98765

Next steps: Mina, can you attach the SOC 2 redacted report and a short note on the FedRAMP assessment scope? Olivia, if you prefer a short call with Mina and Monica this week to walk the security team through artifacts, we can schedule 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_Compliance_Roadmap_Q1-2026.pdf (application/pdf, 298 KB)

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance roadmap questions: ISO 27001, FedRAMP readiness, and audit evidence

Thanks Karthik — that helps. A few clarifying items the team flagged: 

1) For ISO 27001, will the Q4 2026 scope include dedicated/private deployments (VPC/on-prem), or is it limited to hosted API? We need to know for our internal compliance mapping.
2) For FedRAMP, can you confirm what parts of the stack are included in the readiness assessment (control plane only, or data plane as well)? Also, are you planning to pursue a JAB or agency authorization?
3) SOC 2: if you can provide a redacted Type II, that should work initially. Later we may request an in-person or NDA'd review of the full report. Please include the control categories tested and the period.

If it's easier, we're happy to take the 30-minute walkthrough — can you propose two slots tomorrow afternoon PST?

Best,
Olivia

Subject: Re: Compliance roadmap questions: ISO 27001, FedRAMP readiness, and audit evidence

Hi Olivia — thanks for the follow-ups. Answers below with links to the artifacts I uploaded.

1) ISO 27001 scope: Q4 2026 audit window will initially cover hosted API (control plane + hosted data plane for our hosted customers). Private deployments (VPC and on-prem) are on our roadmap for certificate extension in a subsequent cycle; we are tracking customer requests and can include specific customers via scoping annexes if required. (Link to scope doc below).

2) FedRAMP posture: The current readiness assessment covers both control plane and hosted data plane components that are part of our hosted offering. We are working with a 3PAO and targeting FedRAMP Ready in H1 2027. At this stage we are pursuing agency authorization paths (agency-sponsored) rather than a JAB submission; we will update if that changes. The readiness report and control mapping (FedRAMP-to-SOC2) are in the drive.

3) SOC 2 Type II: Attached is the redacted SOC2 report for the 12 months ending 2025. Control categories tested include: CC1 (HR & personnel), CC2 (Logical access), CC3 (Change management), CC4 (Availability & monitoring), CC5 (Encryption & key management). For full report access we'll require an NDA and an asset-specific redaction process — happy to coordinate.

4) SIG/CAIQ: Latest SIG exported (March 2026) and CAIQ answers are available; for speed we typically provide CAIQ answers directly and SIG if the customer needs deeper evidence.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll upload the redacted SOC2 now and grant Acme a time-limited view link.
- If you'd like the walkthrough, Karthik/Monica and I are available tomorrow 2:00–2:30 PM PST or 4:00–4:30 PM PST. Please pick one and we'll send a calendar invite.

Links and attachments:
- Redacted SOC2 report: https://secure.redwood.ai/soc2/ACME-view?token=redacted-token (time-limited)
- ISO scope doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/Compliance/ISO27001_scope_Q4-2026
- FedRAMP readiness report (draft): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/Compliance/FedRAMP_Readiness_Draft

Attachment: SOC2-Report-2025-redacted.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2 MB)

Thanks — happy to sync live if that helps accelerate things.

Mina Haddad
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
